test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If sec θ + tan θ = 4, then sec θ - tan θ = ____________.
solution:
Given

sec θ + tan θ = 4

Formula used

sec2 θ - tan2 θ = 1

Calculation

sec θ + tan θ = 4

sec2 θ - tan2 θ = (sec θ + tan θ)(sec θ - tan θ)

tan θ + sec θ = 1/tan θ - sec θ 

sec θ - tan θ = 1/4

The answer is 1/4.
